settings.welcome_text:
To transcribe and summarize your meetings with AI, you need a Google Gemini API key.
You can get one for free in under a minute at Google AI Studio.
On the free tier, Google may use the submitted content to improve its products. For confidential meetings, use a key with billing enabled.
